tests.question: Can Asteria use the Atlas Business Corpus in a commercial product?
tests.expected: Not under D01 alone. D01 limits use to internal non-production research and evaluation and prohibits commercial use.

tests.question: May HelixLM be deployed to customers through Asteria's hosted service?
tests.expected: Yes, if customers access it through Asteria's hosted service and do not receive the model weights.

tests.question: When is the VectorGrid usage report due?
tests.expected: Within 15 calendar days after each calendar quarter.

tests.question: How does the Horizon Bank subscription renew?
tests.expected: It renews for successive 12-month periods unless either party gives at least 60 days' written notice.

tests.question: Which product receives a commercial-use permission under the Atlas amendment?
tests.expected: ClauseLens Enterprise only. The amendment does not authorise Atlas use in DealRoom Search or other products.

tests.question: When must Asteria notify Horizon Bank of a security incident?
tests.expected: Within 24 hours after confirmation that a Security Incident affects Horizon Bank Customer Data.

tests.question: Which legal entity is licensed to use OCRVision API?
tests.expected: Asteria AI UK Ltd. The agreement does not grant rights to affiliates unless VisionCore consents in writing.

tests.question: Is the ReportForge order form currently effective?
tests.expected: No. It is an unsigned draft and states that it has no effect until signed by both parties.

tests.question: Can Asteria hand HelixLM's model weights to a customer?
tests.expected: No. Customers may access functionality through the hosted service, but the weights may not be distributed.

tests.question: May raw Atlas records be exposed to ClauseLens customers after the amendment?
tests.expected: No. D05 permits limited use in ClauseLens but prohibits exposing or distributing the underlying data to customers.

tests.question: What recurring evidence must Asteria give VectorGrid?
tests.expected: A quarterly usage report showing documents processed and active production workspaces.

tests.question: Does every service outage trigger Horizon Bank's 24-hour incident notice?
tests.expected: No. The 24-hour notice applies only after confirmation that a Security Incident affects Horizon Bank Customer Data.

decision_rules: Compter chaque produit une seule fois dans la catégorie la plus prioritaire.
Ordre de priorité: restriction explicite, preuve insuffisante, droit commercial documenté.
Appliquer une autorisation uniquement au produit, à l'entité et à la période couverts.
Écarter les brouillons non signés comme preuve de droits effectifs.
Répondre information insuffisante lorsque la preuve manque.
Ne jamais présenter l'ARR concerné comme une perte certaine ou une valorisation.
